title: Deploy Threshold persona recross and root discovery manifest
body: Commits 4987b0900 and d72a3f542 make OAuth state mandatory and preserved across request, persisted handshake, browser authorization completion, and redirect; legacy pending persona crossings without state now fail closed and must restart. The human completion route is explicitly documented as a browser-auth exception to the Threshold agent-action invariant. Adds metame://agent-manifest and shared T2-safe discovery vocabulary using existing gateway resources and canonical domain adapters. Deploy trigger is folded into the substantive completion commit.
